patch_description:
A compact, highly symmetric hierarchical variational ansatz with deliberate parameter sharing to reduce the parameter count to 60 per full block (and 60 total after accounting for uploads/repeats). The design preserves the Tic-Tac-Toe grid symmetry and uses:
- Pre- and post- entanglement RZ layers with corner/edge/center groups
- Shared RY layers across corners/edges/center
- Ring CZ entanglement on the outer perimeter
- Ring CRX entanglement with a single shared parameter across the ring
- Center-to-edge hub entanglement with a single shared parameter across hub edges
Crucially, the center parameters are shared between pre and post layers (rz_center), reducing duplication and enabling a stronger second-repeat amplitude control. This structure aims to reduce depth and total parameters while maintaining expressive power, improving validation/test accuracy and reducing train-test gap relative to the previous designs.
